name: Ancien au bâton d’appui
description: A very elderly stocky chief with pale sand skin, large dark forehead mottling, long amber-grey dreadlocks bound in broad cloth rings and an old unmasked Yautja face. Slight natural forward lean with a sturdy bronze-topped walking staff held close and FULLY inside frame. Rich russet robe, wide ivory collar with three round reliefs, dark layered leg wraps. His free hand rests on his upper waist.
